ranked.text: Feature-service issues an unusually high number of SQL statements per feature build, inflating feature build duration.
Feature-service build latency is elevated enough to propagate into forecast-pipeline p95 slowdown.
Failed or retried pipeline runs during the incident window inflate the p95 duration of forecast-pipeline.
Demand data incompleteness or staleness stresses the pipeline validation gate or feature-building path, contributing to longer forecast-pipeline runs.
A recent GitOps commit or rollout touching feature-service or forecast-pipeline introduced the latency regression.
